baseline_text.src/culturemech/schema/culturemech.yaml:
id: https://w3id.org/culturemech
name: culturemech
title: CultureMech - Microbial Growth Media Schema
description: |
  LinkML schema for modeling microbial culture media recipes and formulations.
  Follows the dismech architecture pattern with descriptor classes for ontology grounding.

license: BSD-3-Clause

prefixes:
  linkml: https://w3id.org/linkml/
  culturemech: https://w3id.org/culturemech/
  biolink: https://w3id.org/biolink/vocab/
  rdfs: http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#
  # Chemicals
  CHEBI: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_
  # Organisms
  NCBITaxon: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCBITaxon_
  # Media databases (authoritative sources)
  DSMZ: https://mediadive.dsmz.de/medium/
  TOGO: http://togodb.org/db/medium/
  ATCC: https://www.atcc.org/products/
  NCIT: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_
  # Algae culture collections
  UTEX: https://utex.org/products/
  CCAP: https://www.ccap.ac.uk/catalogue/strain-
  SAG: https://sagdb.uni-goettingen.de/detailedList.php?str_number=
  # Lab procedures
  OBI: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_
  # Environmental conditions
  ENVO: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_
  # Units
  UO: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UO_
  # Anatomy (for tissue extracts)
  UBERON: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UBERON_
  # Food products (peptone, yeast extract, wheat germ, etc.)
  FOODON: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/FOODON_
  # Upstream MediaDive compound URI (kept alongside CHEBI grounding on solution composition entries)
  mediadive.compound: https://mediadive.dsmz.de/compound/
  # References
  PMID: http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/
  DOI: https://doi.org/
  # Pathways
  KEGG: https://www.genome.jp/entry/
  EC: https://enzyme.expasy.org/EC/
  # Data repositories
  geo: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=
  sra: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sra/
  # Genomic taxonomy
  GTDB: https://gtdb.ecogenomic.org/genome?gid=
  # Genome assemblies
  RefSeq: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/datasets/genome/
  GenBank: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/assembly/
  BioSample: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/biosample/
  # Suppliers
  sigma: https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/catalog/product/
  thermofisher: https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/

default_prefix: culturemech
default_range: string

imports:
  - linkml:types
  # Shared, byte-identical Mech module: Discussion (knowledge gaps) + Dataset
  # (+ DatasetTypeEnum/DatasetRepositoryEnum). Replaces the former local Dataset
  # class + DatasetTypeEnum. Vendored + sha-pinned across the Mechs — claw#7.
  - mech_shared
  # MIM-authored ingredient role facet enums (NutritionalRoleEnum /
  # PhysicochemicalRoleEnum / CellularMetabolicRoleEnum). Vendored + sha-pinned;
  # source of truth lives in MediaIngredientMech#129 + #134. Referenced by the
  # three faceted role slots on IngredientDescriptor.
  - mim_roles

# ================================================================
# ROOT CLASS
# ================================================================

classes:
  MediaRecipe:
    class_uri: culturemech:MediaRecipe
    description: >-
      A complete growth medium formulation for culturing microorganisms.
      This is the root entity - one per YAML file.
    attributes:
      id:
        description: >-
          Stable canonical external CultureMech identifier for this media recipe.
          Immutable after issuance and never reused; lifecycle is published in
          data/culturemech_recipe_catalog.tsv.
        range: string
        identifier: true
        required: true
        pattern: "^CultureMech:(?!000000)\\d{6}$"

      id_lineage_token:
        description: >-
          Internal immutable lineage witness for legacy records that predate the
          ID-assignment curation event. This is not an external identifier and
          must never be copied to another record or changed after publication.
        range: string
        pattern: "^legacy:[0-9a-f]{64}$"

      name:
        description: Human-readable medium name (e.g., "LB Broth", "M9 Minimal Medium")
        required: true
        range: string

      original_name:
        description: >-
          Original name from source database before filename sanitization.
          May contain special characters like /, :, %, (, ), ', ", <, >, &, #, etc.
          This field preserves the exact name as it appears in the source database.
        range: string
        required: false

      category:
        description: Broad category for organization
        range: CategoryEnum
        recommended: true

      categories:
        description: All categories this recipe appears in (for cross-category merges)
        range: CategoryEnum
        multivalued: true
        comments:
          - Used when recipes from different categories are merged based on identical ingredients
          - Preserves all original category assignments

      high_metal:
        description: >-
          Indicates media with total metal concentration above the 90th percentile threshold (≥1049.84 mM).
          Metals include Fe, Cu, Zn, Mn, Co, Ni, Mo, Se, W, V, Cr, Ca, Mg, K, Na.
          Based on automated concentration analysis of ingredient composition.
        range: boolean
        recommended: false
        comments:
          - Threshold computed from distribution of 9,599 media with detectable metal content
          - Useful for identifying high-metal media for metal toxicity studies or bioremediation applications

      high_ree:
        description: >-
          Indicates media with total rare earth element (REE) concentration above the 90th percentile threshold (≥1030.48 mM).
          REEs include lanthanides (La, Ce, Pr, Nd, Pm, Sm, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, Yb, Lu) plus Sc and Y.
          Based on automated concentration analysis of ingredient composition.
        range: boolean
        recommended: false
        comments:
          - Threshold computed from distribution of 9,130 media with detectable REE content
          - Useful for identifying specialized media for REE extraction or bioaccumulation research

      synonyms:
        description: Alternate names from merged duplicate recipes
        range: RecipeSynonym
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        comments:
          - Populated during merge process when duplicate recipes are consolidated
          - Tracks all non-canonical names with their source provenance

      merged_from:
        description: Original recipe IDs that were merged into this record
        range: string
        multivalued: true
        comments:
          - List of recipe file IDs that were consolidated into this canonical record
          - "Format: source_id_sanitized_name (e.g., TOGO_M3236_Luria_Bertani_LB_medium)"

      merge_fingerprint:
        description: SHA256 hash of ingredient set for deduplication tracking
        range: string
        comments:
          - Generated from sorted list of CHEBI IDs and normalized ingredient names
          - Includes both direct ingredients and solution compositions
          - Order-independent, concentration-independent

      chemical_fingerprint:
        description: SHA256 hash using parent ingredients (hierarchy-aware)
        range: string
        comments:
          - Treats chemical variants as equivalent (CaCl2·2H2O = CaCl2)
          - Uses parent CHEBI IDs from MediaIngredientMech hierarchy
          - Enables smart merging of hydrates, salt forms, and anhydrous variants
          - Generated only when hierarchy enrichment is available

      variant_fingerprint:
        description: SHA256 hash preserving variant distinctions
        range: string
        comments:
          - Keeps hydrates separate from anhydrous forms
          - Uses parent CHEBI + variant type (HYDRATE, ANHYDROUS, SALT_FORM, etc.)
          - Preserves important chemical specificity during merge
          - Generated only when hierarchy enrichment is available

      fingerprint_version:
        description: Version of fingerprinting algorithm used
        range: string
        comments:
          - Example "hierarchy-chemical-v1.0" or "original-v1.0"
          - Enables tracking algorithm changes over time
          - Used to determine which fingerprints are comparable

      merge_metadata:
        description: Metadata about merge process and quality
        range: MergeMetadata
        inlined: true
        comments:
          - Provides transparency about merge decisions
          - Enables quality analysis and debugging
          - Populated during hierarchy-aware merge pipeline

      media_term:
        description: Reference to authoritative media database
        range: MediaTypeDescriptor
        recommended: true

      kg_microbe_match:
        description: >-
          KG-Microbe mediadive.medium node ID for exact ingredient match.
          Populated when this recipe's ingredients exactly match a medium in KG-Microbe
          (ignoring concentrations, considering hierarchical ingredient resolution).
        range: string
        required: false
        pattern: "^mediadive\\.medium:[0-9a-zA-Z_-]+$"
        comments:
          - Format mediadive.medium:514, mediadive.medium:693, mediadive.medium:92
          - Match criteria same ingredient set (CHEBI/FOODON IDs) regardless of concentrations
          - Handles hierarchical ingredients (commercial products vs constituent chemicals)
          - Enables validation against authoritative DSMZ formulations

      description:
        description: Overview of the medium and its purpose
        range: string
        multivalued: false

      target_organisms:
        description: Organisms for which this medium is designed
        range: OrganismDescriptor
        multivalued: true
        recommended: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      source_environment:
        description: >-
          Environment(s) from which target organisms originate or for which
          this medium is designed. Enables environment-based queries and linking
          to CommunityMech environmental metadata.
        range: SourceEnvironmentDescriptor
        multivalued: true
        required: false
        inlined_as_list: true
        comments:
          - Optional field for backward compatibility
          - Multivalued to support media used for multiple environments
          - Use when environment is known or can be inferred from target organisms
          - Enables queries like "find all media for marine organisms"

      organism_culture_type:
        description: >-
          Whether this medium targets a pure isolate culture or a
          mixed microbial community
        range: OrganismCultureTypeEnum
        recommended: true

      record_kind:
        description: >-
          What kind of record this is: a growth MEDIUM, or a standalone stock
          SOLUTION. Normally inferred from the `term.id` prefix
          (`mediadive.solution:*`), and only stated explicitly for solutions that
          carry no upstream solution identifier — 202 records imported from KOMODO
          as media ("Trace element solution (medium 929)", "10 x M9 salts") whose
          composition was flattened into their parent medium.
          A curated assertion, written by `just retype-solution-records` and
          reviewable in the diff. It is NOT derived from the name at read time:
          matching "*solution*" would silently reclassify a genuine medium such as
          Ringer's solution.
        range: RecordKindEnum
      medium_type:
        description: >-
          MAINTAINED compatibility axis, derived from composition_type. It is the
          single-valued classification published to downstream consumers: kgx_export
          emits one edge per record from this slot, so it is load-bearing rather than
          vestigial. Populate it on every record, and keep it consistent with
          composition_type — DEFINED maps to DEFINED, UNDEFINED and SEMI_DEFINED both
          map to COMPLEX. BUFFER and NEGATIVE_CONTROL have no composition_type
          counterpart and are curated directly. Use `just curate-medium-type` to stamp
          it; a guard fails the build if any record is missing it or contradicts
          composition_type.
        range: MediumTypeEnum

      composition_type:
        description: >-
          Composition axis — how chemically defined the medium is (DEFINED / UNDEFINED /
          SEMI_DEFINED). Supersedes the DEFINED/COMPLEX values of the deprecated
          medium_type slot.
        range: MediumCompositionTypeEnum
        recommended: true

      nutritional_class:
        description: >-
          Nutritional-level axis — MINIMAL / RICH / GENERAL_PURPOSE. Orthogonal to
          composition_type and functional_role.
        range: MediumNutritionalClassEnum

      functional_role:
        description: >-
          Functional-role axis — what the medium is designed to do (SELECTIVE, DIFFERENTIAL,
          ENRICHMENT, GENERAL_PURPOSE, TRANSPORT, ASSAY, ENUMERATION). Multivalued: a medium
          may have more than one role.
        range: MediumFunctionalRoleEnum
        multivalued: true

      physical_state:
        description: Physical form of the medium
        range: PhysicalStateEnum
        required: true

      ph_value:
        description: Target pH value
        range: float

      ph_range:
        description: Acceptable pH range. Structured as PhRange (min/max floats; notes for unparseable values).
        range: PhRange
        inlined: true

      # Algae-specific culture conditions
      light_intensity:
        description: Light intensity for photosynthetic organisms (e.g., "50 µmol photons m⁻² s⁻¹")
        range: string
        comments:
          - For algae and cyanobacteria cultures
          - "Common units: µE/m²/s, µmol photons m⁻² s⁻¹, lux, or foot-candles"

      light_cycle:
        description: Photoperiod light:dark cycle (e.g., "16:8", "continuous light", "24:0")
        range: string
        comments:
          - For algae and cyanobacteria cultures
          - "Format: hours_light:hours_dark"

      light_quality:
        description: Light spectrum or wavelength (e.g., "cool white fluorescent", "red LED 660nm")
        range: string
        comments:
          - For algae and cyanobacteria cultures

      temperature_range:
        description: Optimal temperature range (e.g., "20-25°C", "room temperature")
        range: string

      temperature_value:
        description: Specific culture temperature in Celsius
        range: float

      salinity:
        description: Salt concentration for marine/brackish media (e.g., "35 ppt", "3.5%")
        range: string
        comments:
          - For marine algae and halophilic organisms

      aeration:
        description: Gas exchange method (e.g., "0.5% CO2 in air", "bubbling", "shaking at 150 rpm")
        range: string

      culture_vessel:
        description: Recommended culture container (e.g., "Erlenmeyer flask", "test tube", "petri dish")
        range: string

      ingredients:
        description: Chemical and biological ingredients
        range: IngredientDescriptor
        multivalued: true
        required: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      solutions:
        description: Pre-prepared stock solutions used as ingredients
        range: SolutionDescriptor
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      preparation_steps:
        description: Ordered steps to prepare the medium
        range: PreparationStep
        multivalued: true
        recommended: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      sterilization:
        description: Sterilization method and parameters
        range: SterilizationDescriptor
        recommended: true
        inlined: true

      storage:
        description: Storage conditions for prepared medium
        range: StorageConditions
        inlined: true

      applications:
        description: Use cases and applications
        range: string
        multivalued: true

      variants:
        description: Related formulations or modifications
        range: MediaVariant
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      parent_media:
        description: >-
          Canonical parent medium when this record is a child/variant
          formulation. Used for parent-child media variant modeling where each
          variant remains a full MediaRecipe YAML record.
        range: MediaRecipeReference
        inlined: true

      variant_children:
        description: >-
          Child MediaRecipe YAML records that are variants of this canonical
          parent medium.
        range: MediaRecipeReference
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      variant_relationship:
        description: >-
          Relationship type to the parent medium when this recipe is a child
          variant record.
        range: MediaVariantRelationshipEnum

      variant_modifications:
        description: >-
          Summary of how this child formulation differs from its parent medium.
        range: string
        multivalued: true

      references:
        description: Original literature sources
        range: PublicationReference
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      notes:
        description: Additional context, historical notes, tips
        range: string

      evidence:
        description: Evidence supporting formulation claims
        range: EvidenceItem
        multivalued: true
        recommended: false
        inlined_as_list: true

      datasets:
        description: Public datasets (omics/sequence/phenotype) generated using this medium
        range: Dataset
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      discussions:
        description: >-
          Open questions, knowledge gaps, controversies, and curation todos
          attached to this medium (shared Discussion supertype; anchor
          `attaches_to` into e.g. `composition#<ingredient>` / `conditions#<x>`).
        range: Discussion
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      import_metadata:
        description: >-
          Import tracking and versioning information.
          Enables reproducible imports, provenance tracking, and update workflows.
        range: ImportMetadata
        inlined: true
        recommended: true
        comments:
          - Populated for all imported media (excludes manually created recipes)
          - Essential for tracking source database versions and updates
          - Enables reproducibility and audit trails

      curation_history:
        description: Audit trail of curation events
        range: CurationEvent
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      data_quality_flags:
        description: Data quality indicators for transparency
        range: string
        multivalued: true
        comments:
          - Used to mark recipes with known quality issues
          - "Common values: incomplete_composition, pending_curation, low_confidence"

      sources:
        description: >-
          Upstream database attribution(s) for this record (e.g. MediaDive,
          CultureBotHT). Multivalued for cross-listings.
        range: SourceReference
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      incubation_atmosphere:
        description: Atmospheric conditions for incubation
        range: AtmosphereEnum
        comments:
          - Indicates whether the organism requires aerobic, anaerobic, or microaerophilic conditions
          - Imported from CommunityMech when available

      source_data:
        description: Provenance tracking for records imported from other repositories
        range: SourceData
        inlined: true
        comments:
          - Records imported from CommunityMech include community IDs and evidence
          - Preserves bidirectional linking between repositories

  SolutionRecipe:
    class_uri: culturemech:SolutionRecipe
    description: >-
      A standalone stock-solution record (one per YAML file). Used for
      pre-prepared solutions that are referenced as ingredients by
      MediaRecipes — e.g. MediaDive's "Main sol." or "Trace metals SL10"
      records. SolutionDescriptor is the inlined-in-recipe form; this is
      the root form with its own id, curation history, and provenance.
    attributes:
      id:
        description: >-
          Stable canonical external CultureMech identifier for this solution record.
          Immutable after issuance and never reused; lifecycle is published in
          data/culturemech_recipe_catalog.tsv.
        range: string
        identifier: true
        required: true
        pattern: "^CultureMech:(?!000000)\\d{6}$"

      id_lineage_token:
        description: >-
          Internal immutable lineage witness for legacy records that predate the
          ID-assignment curation event. This is not an external identifier and
          must never be copied to another record or changed after publication.
        range: string
        pattern: "^legacy:[0-9a-f]{64}$"

      preferred_term:
        description: Solution name (e.g., "Trace Metal Solution", "Vitamin Stock")
        required: true
        range: string

      term:
        description: Ontology term identifying this solution
        range: Term
        inlined: true

      mediaingredientmech_term:
        description: Legacy MediaIngredientMech:NNNNNN identifier for this solution (pre-CHEBI-keying).
        range: MediaIngredientMechTerm
        recommended: false
        inlined: true

      mediaingredientmech_chebi_term:
        description: CHEBI-keyed linkage to a curated MediaIngredientMech ingredient (current MIM schema).
        range: MediaIngredientMechChebiTerm
        recommended: false
        inlined: true

      culturemech_term:
        description: Reference to another CultureMech recipe (if this solution is also catalogued there)
        range: CultureMechTerm
        recommended: false
        inlined: true

      category:
        description: Source / collection category (algae, bacterial, fungal, …)
        range: CategoryEnum

      composition:
        description: Ingredients in the stock solution
        range: IngredientDescriptor
        multivalued: true
        required: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      solutions:
        description: Nested stock solutions added while preparing this stock solution
        range: SolutionDescriptor
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      ingredients:
        description: >-
          Placeholder/stub ingredient entries from upstream imports (kept
          alongside the authoritative `composition`). Intended to be
          empty or carry a "See source for composition" marker.
        range: IngredientDescriptor
        multivalued: true
        recommended: false
        inlined_as_list: true

      concentration:
        description: Working concentration when added to a medium
        range: ConcentrationValue
        inlined: true

      preparation_notes:
        description: How to prepare the stock solution
        range: string

      storage_conditions:
        description: Storage requirements
        range: StorageConditions
        inlined: true

      shelf_life:
        description: Stability duration (e.g., "6 months at 4°C")
        range: string

      references:
        description: Source references for this solution
        range: PublicationReference
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      source_data:
        description: Provenance tracking for imported solution records
        range: SourceData
        inlined: true

      curation_history:
        description: Audit trail of curation events
        range: CurationEvent
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      data_quality_flags:
        description: Data quality indicators
        range: string
        multivalued: true

      sources:
        description: Upstream database attribution(s) for this solution record.
        range: SourceReference
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      notes:
        description: Additional free-text notes
        range: string

  RecipeSynonym:
    description: An alternate name for a recipe from a specific source
    attributes:
      name:
        description: Alternate recipe name (non-canonical)
        required: true
        range: string

      source:
        description: Source database (KOMODO, MediaDive, TOGO, etc.)
        required: true
        range: string

      source_id:
        description: Original identifier in source database
        range: string

      original_category:
        description: Original category assignment before merge
        range: CategoryEnum

  MergeMetadata:
    description: Metadata about merge process and quality
    attributes:
      merge_version:
        description: Version of merge pipeline used
        range: string
        comments:
          - Example "hierarchy-v1.0"
          - Enables tracking pipeline changes

      merge_mode:
        description: Merge mode used (conservative/aggressive/variant-aware)
        range: MergeModeEnum
        comments:
          - CONSERVATIVE - Only merge with explicit rules or exact match
          - AGGRESSIVE - Merge all variants with same parent
          - VARIANT_AWARE - Balanced approach, merge some variants

      merge_reason:
        description: Why these recipes were merged together
        range: MergeReasonEnum
        comments:
          - Indicates which merge rule triggered the merge
          - Used for quality analysis and debugging

      merge_confidence:
        description: Confidence score for merge decision (0.0-1.0)
        range: float
        comments:
          - 1.0 = Explicit merge rule (highest confidence)
          - 0.9 = Identical fingerprint
          - 0.8 = Same parent ingredients
          - 0.7 = Hydration variant only

      hierarchy_conflicts:
        description: Ingredients with conflicting merge signals
        range: string
        multivalued: true
        comments:
          - Used to flag potential quality issues
          - Example "CaCl2 has multiple parent assignments"

      fingerprint_mode:
        description: Fingerprinting mode used (chemical/variant/original)
        range: FingerprintModeEnum
        comments:
          - Indicates which fingerprint algorithm was used
          - Enables comparing merge results across modes

# ================================================================
# BASE DESCRIPTOR PATTERN (following dismech)
# ================================================================

  Descriptor:
    abstract: true
    description: >-
      Base class for descriptor pattern.
      Descriptors have a human-readable preferred_term and optional ontology term.

  Term:
    abstract: true
    description: >-
      Base class for ontology term references.
      Subclasses specify id_prefixes for validation.
    attributes:
      id:
        description: Ontology identifier (CURIE)
        identifier: true
        required: true
        range: string
      label:
        slot_uri: rdfs:label
        description: >-
          CANONICAL ontology label for `id` (e.g. "magnesium sulfate" for
          CHEBI:32599). Verified against the ontology by the id↔label gate;
          the sibling `preferred_term` holds the free/source name.
        range: string
      confidence:
        description: Confidence score for the mapping (0.0-1.0). Populated by automated grounding pipelines.
        range: float
      match_type:
        description: Provenance/method of the term mapping (e.g. "kg_fallback", "exact", "manual_curated").
        range: TermMatchTypeEnum

# ================================================================
# DESCRIPTOR CLASSES
# ================================================================

  MediaTypeDescriptor:
    is_a: Descriptor
    description: Classification and authoritative database reference for the medium
    attributes:
      preferred_term:
        description: Medium designation in source database (e.g., "DSMZ Medium 1", "LB")
        required: true
        range: string
      term:
        description: Authoritative media database identifier
        range: MediaDatabaseTerm
        recommended: true
        inlined: true

  IngredientDescriptor:
    is_a: Descriptor
    description: Chemical or biological ingredient in a medium
    attributes:
      preferred_term:
        description: Human-readable ingredient name (e.g., "Glucose", "Yeast Extract")
        required: true
        range: string

      term:
        description: Primary ontology grounding (CHEBI, FOODON, UBERON, ENVO, or upstream mediadive.compound).
        range: ChemicalEntityTerm
        # NOTE: intentionally NO `binds_value_of: id` canonical-label binding.
        # `term`/`chebi_term` carry CURATOR-intended formula/common-name labels
        # (e.g. CHEBI:15377 "Distilled water", CHEBI:26710 "NaCl") that are
        # deliberately not the OBO canonical label. Enforcing the canonical
        # label here (linkml-term-validator --labels, Engine A) would directly
        # contradict the Engine-B label waiver (conf/id_label_targets.yaml:
        # label_waived_keys: [term, chebi_term]) and flag the very rows that
        # waiver exists to accept. id-existence is still checked by Engine B.
        # Canonical-label bindings ARE kept on organism/environment/precursor/
        # substrate terms, whose labels are canonical.
        recommended: true
        inlined: true

      chebi_term:
        description: CHEBI-only grounding kept alongside `term` when `term` carries the upstream identifier (e.g. mediadive.compound on solution compositions).
        range: ChebiTerm
        # No canonical-label binding — see the `term` slot note above; same
        # curator-label policy and Engine-B waiver apply.
        recommended: false
        inlined: true

      mediaingredientmech_term:
        description: Legacy MediaIngredientMech:NNNNNN identifier for this ingredient (pre-CHEBI-keying).
        range: MediaIngredientMechTerm
        recommended: false
        inlined: true

      mediaingredientmech_chebi_term:
        description: CHEBI-keyed linkage to a curated MediaIngredientMech ingredient (current MIM schema).
        range: MediaIngredientMechChebiTerm
        recommended: false
        inlined: true

      culturemech_term:
        description: Reference to another CultureMech media recipe used as component
        range: CultureMechTerm
        recommended: false
        inlined: true
        comments:
          - Used when this ingredient is actually a complete medium or stock solution
          - "Example: A medium that uses BG-11 as a base would reference CultureMech:009592"

      parent_ingredient:
        description: Reference to parent chemical entity from MediaIngredientMech
        range: IngredientReference
        recommended: false
        inlined: true
        comments:
          - Links to canonical parent in MediaIngredientMech hierarchy
          - Example CaCl2·2H2O → parent is "Calcium chloride"

      variant_type:
        description: Type of chemical variant
        range: VariantTypeEnum
        recommended: false
        comments:
          - Describes relationship to parent (HYDRATE, SALT_FORM, ANHYDROUS, etc.)
          - Populated from MediaIngredientMech metadata

      concentration:
        description: >-
          Amount of ingredient. Recommended but not required: pH-adjustment
          ingredients (HCl/H2SO4/NaOH/KOH titrated "to pH") and similar
          "to-effect" reagents legitimately lack a fixed concentration.
        range: ConcentrationValue
        recommended: true
        inlined: true

      modifier:
        description: Modification in variants (INCREASED, DECREASED)
        range: ModifierEnum

      chemical_formula:
        description: Molecular formula (e.g., "C6H12O6")
        range: string

      synonyms:
        description: >-
          Alternate names for this ingredient (e.g. brand names, abbreviations).
          Each entry is an `IngredientSynonym` with `synonym_text` and `synonym_type`.
        range: IngredientSynonym
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      source:
        description: Provenance attribution for this ingredient entry.
        range: string

      curation_metadata:
        description: >-
          Structured curation metadata for this ingredient mapping (mapping
          quality, confidence score, ontology source, etc.).
        range: IngredientCurationMetadata
        inlined: true

      data_quality_flags:
        description: Ingredient-level data quality indicators.
        range: string
        multivalued: true

      molecular_weight:
        description: Molecular weight in g/mol
        range: float

      supplier_catalog:
        description: Supplier information for sourcing
        range: SupplierInfo
        inlined: true

      notes:
        description: Preparation notes specific to this ingredient
        range: string

      nutritional_roles:
        description: >-
          What element or macronutrient this ingredient supplies to the
          medium (facet 1 of 3). Multiple values allowed — L-cysteine
          → [AMINO_ACID_SOURCE, SULFUR_SOURCE]. Vocabulary imported
          from MIM (`mim_roles.NutritionalRoleEnum`); MIM owns the ingredient
          identity layer + evidence-bearing assignment surface, this slot
          carries CultureMech recipe-scoped assertions or overrides.
        range: NutritionalRoleEnum
        multivalued: true

      physicochemical_roles:
        description: >-
          Chemical or physical function this ingredient performs in the
          medium (facet 2 of 3), independent of what element it supplies —
          BUFFER, CHELATOR, REDUCING_AGENT, PH_INDICATOR, etc. Vocabulary
          imported from MIM (`mim_roles.PhysicochemicalRoleEnum`).
        range: PhysicochemicalRoleEnum
        multivalued: true

      cellular_metabolic_roles:
        description: >-
          Role of this ingredient inside/on the cultured microbe (facet 3
          of 3) — SUBSTRATE, ELECTRON_DONOR, COFACTOR, INHIBITOR, etc.
          Often organism-conditional (e.g., methanol → ELECTRON_DONOR only
          for methylotrophs). Vocabulary imported from MIM
          (`mim_roles.CellularMetabolicRoleEnum`).
        range: CellularMetabolicRoleEnum
        multivalued: true

      role_curie:
        description: >-
          Escape-hatch CURIE(s) for out-of-vocabulary role terms not covered
          by the three facet enums. Should resolve within a recognized role
          namespace (CHEBI role subtree under CHEBI:50906, METPO, ENVO, GO,
          PATO, NCIT). Use sparingly — prefer a facet enum value where one
          fits.
        range: uriorcurie
        multivalued: true

      cofactors_provided:
        description: Cofactors supplied by this ingredient
        range: CofactorDescriptor
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      evidence:
        description: Evidence for this ingredient's role
        range: EvidenceItem
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

  SolutionDescriptor:
    is_a: Descriptor
    description: A pre-prepared stock solution used as an ingredient
    attributes:
      preferred_term:
        description: Solution name (e.g., "Trace Metal Solution", "Vitamin Stock")
        required: true
        range: string

      name:
        description: Human-readable solution label (kept alongside preferred_term).
        range: string

      notes:
        description: Free-text notes about this solution as used in the parent recipe.
        range: string

      source:
        description: Provenance attribution for this solution entry.
        range: string

      term:
        description: Ontology term if available
        range: Term
        inlined: true

      mediaingredientmech_term:
        description: Legacy MediaIngredientMech:NNNNNN identifier for this solution component (pre-CHEBI-keying).
        range: MediaIngredientMechTerm
        recommended: false
        inlined: true

      mediaingredientmech_chebi_term:
        description: CHEBI-keyed linkage to a curated MediaIngredientMech ingredient (current MIM schema).
        range: MediaIngredientMechChebiTerm
        recommended: false
        inlined: true

      culturemech_term:
        description: Reference to another CultureMech media recipe for this solution
        range: CultureMechTerm
        recommended: false
        inlined: true
        comments:
          - Used when this solution is defined as a complete recipe in CultureMech
          - "Example: Bold Trace Stock (CultureMech:015441)"

      composition:
        description: >-
          Ingredients in the stock solution. Optional when the solution is
          referenced by name only (no inline composition copied from the source).
        range: IngredientDescriptor
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      solutions:
        description: Nested stock solutions added while preparing this stock solution
        range: SolutionDescriptor
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      concentration:
        description: Working concentration when added to medium
        range: ConcentrationValue
        inlined: true
        comments:
          - >-
            ASSERTED values only — a figure read from this medium's own source.
            A value inferred from other media goes in `concentration_candidates`
            and must never be written here, so a reader can always tell what the
            source said from what a tool concluded.

      concentration_candidates:
        description: >-
          Proposed working concentrations that are NOT asserted — each carries the
          basis it rests on and the evidence for it. Never overwrites
          `concentration`; a curator promotes one by hand after checking it.
        range: ConcentrationCandidate
        multivalued: true
        recommended: false
        inlined_as_list: true
        comments:
          - >-
            Multivalued because the evidence genuinely disagrees. The DSMZ stock
            "Trace element solution SL-10" is added at 1 ml/L in ten MediaDive
            media and at 0.05 ml/L in J537 (TREPONEMA ISOPTEROCOLA) — a 20x
            spread. A single inferred-value slot would force a tool to pick one
            and hide the other; an array lets both stand with their support until
            someone reads that medium's own recipe.
          - >-
            Introduced for the #150 cocktail repair, where a flattened stock's
            addition volume is often recoverable only by inference.

      preparation_notes:
        description: How to prepare the stock solution
        range: string

      storage_conditions:
        description: Storage requirements for the stock
        range: StorageConditions
        inlined: true

      shelf_life:
        description: Stability duration (e.g., "6 months at 4°C")
        range: string

  OrganismDescriptor:
    is_a: Descriptor
    description: Target organism for the medium
    attributes:
      preferred_term:
        description: Organism name (e.g., "Escherichia coli")
        required: true
        identifier: true
        range: string

      term:
        description: NCBITaxon identifier
        range: OrganismTerm
        bindings:
          - binds_value_of: id
            obligation_level: REQUIRED
        required: false
        inlined: true

      scoped_to_variant:
        description: >-
          Name of the `variants[]` entry this organism's growth evidence is
          scoped to, when growth is verified only on a specific variant of the
          medium and NOT on the parent recipe. Must match a `variants[].name`
          on the same record. Downstream KG builds should attach the
          organism<->medium edge to the named variant rather than the parent,
          so variant-only evidence is not propagated as a parent-medium claim.
        range: string

      gtdb_term:
        description: GTDB genome or lineage identifier (alternative to NCBITaxon)
        range: GTDBTerm
        inlined: true

      genome_assembly_id:
        description: >-
          Genome assembly accession(s) for this organism, complementing gtdb_term.
          Accepts RefSeq (GCF_), GenBank (GCA_), or BioSample (SAMN) identifiers.
        range: string
        multivalued: true
        pattern: "^(GCF_|GCA_|SAMN)[0-9.]+$"
        comments:
          - "Examples: GCF_000005845.2, GCA_000005845.2, SAMN02604091"
          - Complements gtdb_term for cases where assembly accession is the primary genome reference

      strain:
        description: Specific strain designation (e.g., "K-12", "MG1655")
        range: string

      growth_phase:
        description: Target growth phase (e.g., "exponential", "stationary")
        range: GrowthPhaseEnum

      growth_metrics:
        description: Quantitative growth measurements observed for this organism on this medium
        range: GrowthMetrics
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        comments:
          - Captures empirical growth performance (max OD, doubling time, growth rate, etc.)
          - Each entry should be tied to a literature reference via its evidence list

      community_role:
        description: Functional role in microbial community (e.g., PRIMARY_DEGRADER, SYNERGIST, COMMENSAL, COMPETITOR).
        range: CommunityOrganismRoleEnum
        multivalued: true

      target_abundance:
        description: Target relative abundance in community (0.0-1.0)
        range: float

      community_function:
        description: Specific functional contribution to community
        range: string
        multivalued: true

      cofactor_requirements:
        description: Cofactors required by this organism
        range: CofactorRequirement
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      transporters:
        description: Annotated transport systems
        range: TransporterAnnotation
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      evidence:
        description: Evidence supporting growth on this medium
        range: EvidenceItem
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      strain_modifications:
        description: >-
          Genotype/phenotype modifications relative to the wild-type or
          type strain. Strain-level (carries across observations) and
          distinct from per-observation `growth_metrics[].perturbations`.
        range: StrainModification
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

  SourceEnvironmentDescriptor:
    is_a: Descriptor
    description: >-
      Environment from which target organisms originate or for which
      the medium is designed. Enables environment-based discovery and
      cross-repository linking with CommunityMech.
    attributes:
      preferred_term:
        description: Human-readable environment name (e.g., "peatland", "marine", "soil")
        required: true
        range: string

      term:
        description: ENVO ontology term for the environment
        range: EnvironmentTerm
        bindings:
          - binds_value_of: id
            obligation_level: REQUIRED
        recommended: true
        inlined: true
        comments:
          - Recommended but not required to allow media without known environment
          - Use ENVO Browser to find appropriate terms

      notes:
        description: Additional environmental context, conditions, or specificity
        range: string
        required: false

    comments:
      - Follows dismech Descriptor pattern used throughout CultureMech
      - Multivalued when added to MediaRecipe (media can serve multiple environments)
      - Optional field - backward compatible with existing records

  CofactorDescriptor:
    is_a: Descriptor
    description: A cofactor or coenzyme required for enzymatic activity
    attributes:
      preferred_term:
        description: Human-readable cofactor name (e.g., "Thiamine pyrophosphate", "NAD")
        required: true
        range: string

      term:
        description: CHEBI term for the cofactor
        range: ChemicalEntityTerm
        bindings:
          - binds_value_of: id
            obligation_level: REQUIRED
        recommended: true
        inlined: true

      category:
        description: High-level classification
        range: CofactorCategoryEnum
        recommended: true

      precursor:
        description: Precursor molecule (e.g., thiamine → TPP)
        range: string

      precursor_term:
        description: CHEBI term for precursor
        range: ChemicalEntityTerm
        bindings:
          - binds_value_of: id
            obligation_level: REQUIRED
        inlined: true

      ec_associations:
        description: EC numbers of enzymes using this cofactor
        range: string
        multivalued: true

      kegg_pathways:
        description: KEGG pathway IDs for biosynthesis
        range: string
        multivalued: true

      enzyme_examples:
        description: Example enzymes requiring this cofactor
        range: string
        multivalued: true

      biosynthesis_genes:
        description: Genes involved in cofactor biosynthesis
        range: string
        multivalued: true

      bioavailability:
        description: Uptake and availability characteristics
        range: string

      notes:
        description: Additional information about the cofactor
        range: string

# ================================================================
# SUPPORTING CLASSES
# ================================================================

  SourceReference:
    description: >-
      Upstream database attribution for a record. Carried alongside
      curation_history; multivalued because a record can have multiple
      upstream sources (e.g. originally from MediaDive, also catalogued in
      CultureBotHT).
    attributes:
      database:
        description: Source database/repository name (e.g. CultureBotHT, MediaDive).
        range: string
        required: true
      database_id:
        description: Identifier or name in the source database.
        range: string
      url:
        description: Direct URL to the source record.
        range: string

  IngredientSynonym:
    description: An alternate name for an ingredient (e.g. brand name, abbreviation).
    attributes:
      synonym_text:
        description: The alternate name string.
        range: string
        required: true
      synonym_type:
        description: Synonym match type (e.g. EXACT, RELATED, BROAD).
        range: SynonymTypeEnum

  IngredientCurationMetadata:
    description: >-
      Structured metadata describing how an ingredient mapping was produced
      (mapping quality, confidence, source). Populated by curation pipelines.
    attributes:
      mapping_quality:
        description: Quality tier of the mapping (e.g. EXACT, LLM_ASSISTED, KG_FALLBACK).
        range: string
      confidence_score:
        description: Confidence score for the mapping (0.0-1.0).
        range: float
      curation_date:
        description: When the curation was performed (ISO-8601).
        range: string
      ontology_source:
        description: Ontology used as the mapping target (e.g. CHEBI).
        range: string

  IngredientReference:
    description: Reference to canonical ingredient
    attributes:
      preferred_term:
        description: Name of parent ingredient
        required: true
        range: string

      mediaingredientmech_id:
        description: MediaIngredientMech ID
        range: string
        pattern: "^MediaIngredientMech:\\d{6}$"

  ConcentrationValue:
    description: Quantified concentration with units
    attributes:
      value:
        description: Numeric value or range
        range: string
        required: true

      unit:
        description: Concentration unit
        range: ConcentrationUnitEnum
        required: true

      per_volume:
        description: Volume basis (e.g., "per liter", "per 100 mL")
        range: string

  ConcentrationCandidate:
    description: >-
      A concentration that has been PROPOSED but not asserted, carrying the basis
      it rests on and the evidence for it.

      This exists so an inferred value can be recorded without being mistaken for
      one that was read from a source. A candidate never overwrites an asserted
      `concentration`; promoting it is a curation decision, made after checking the
      record's own source.
    attributes:
      value:
        description: Numeric value or range, as the evidence gives it.
        range: string
        required: true

      unit:
        description: Concentration unit
        range: ConcentrationUnitEnum
        required: true

      basis:
        description: What kind of claim this is — how the value was arrived at.
        range: ConcentrationBasisEnum
        required: true

      support:
        description: >-
          The evidence, stated so it can be re-checked, e.g. "10 of 11 MediaDive
          media citing this stock add it at this volume".
        range: string
        recommended: true

      counterevidence:
        description: >-
          Evidence AGAINST this candidate, where any is known. Recorded because a
          candidate offered without its known counterexample invites the reader to
          trust it more than the evidence allows.
        range: string

      source:
        description: Citation or URL the support was read from.
        range: string
        recommended: true

      proposed_by:
        description: Script or curator that proposed the value.
        range: string

      proposed_on:
        description: ISO-8601 date the proposal was made.
        range: string

  GrowthMetrics:
    description: >-
      Quantitative growth measurements for an organism on a medium.
      Captures empirical growth performance (max OD, doubling time, growth rate)
      observed under defined conditions. Every non-empty record must cite at least
      one literature reference via the evidence list.
    attributes:
      max_od600:
        description: Maximum optical density observed (default wavelength 600 nm)
        range: float

      max_od_wavelength_nm:
        description: Wavelength at which OD was measured, in nanometers (default 600)
        range: integer
        ifabsent: int(600)

      doubling_time_minutes:
        description: Population doubling time in minutes
        range: float

      growth_rate_per_hour:
        description: Specific growth rate μ in h⁻¹ (inverse hours)
        range: float

      temperature_celsius:
        description: Temperature at which the measurement was taken, in degrees Celsius
        range: float

      ph_at_measurement:
        description: Medium pH at the time of measurement
        range: float

      measurement_conditions:
        description: >-
          Free-text description of measurement context (e.g., "shake flask, 200 rpm",
          "microtiter plate, 96-well, plate reader Tecan Spark")
        range: string

      evidence:
        description: Literature evidence supporting these growth measurements
        range: EvidenceItem
        multivalued: true
        required: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        comments:
          - Required for any populated GrowthMetrics record
          - Each evidence item should cite the paper reporting the measurement

      is_max_attainment:
        description: >-
          TRUE when the metric represents max-attained / standard / textbook
          growth on this medium for this organism. FALSE when it's
          conditional on a perturbation, mutation, or non-default condition
          (in which case `perturbations` and/or the OrganismDescriptor's
          `strain_modifications` should be populated). Optional; absence
          means "not asserted either way".
        range: boolean

      growth_mode:
        description: Cultivation mode under which the metric was measured.
        range: GrowthModeEnum

      perturbations:
        description: >-
          Applied stresses, modifications, or non-default conditions that
          accompanied this growth observation. When non-empty,
          `is_max_attainment` should typically be FALSE.
        range: PerturbationContext
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      nutrient_overrides:
        description: >-
          C/N/S/electron-source nutrients used in this observation that
          differ from the recipe's prescribed ingredients (e.g.,
          "succinate as sole carbon source", "L-phenylalanine as sole
          nitrogen source").
        range: NutrientOverride
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

  PerturbationContext:
    description: >-
      A non-default condition under which a growth metric was observed —
      chemical stress, temperature stress, nutrient limitation, adaptation,
      or non-batch culture mode. When PerturbationContext is non-empty,
      GrowthMetrics.is_max_attainment should be FALSE (the metric is
      conditional, not a max claim).
    attributes:
      perturbation_type:
        description: Class of perturbation applied during the observation.
        range: PerturbationTypeEnum
        required: true

      descriptor:
        description: >-
          Free-text description (e.g. "Cr(VI) at 10 mg/L",
          "magnetosome-deficient strain", "cellulose-adapted",
          "induced at OD600=0.6").
        range: string

      target:
        description: >-
          Subject of the perturbation — gene/locus for genetic, stressor
          compound for chemical, limiting nutrient for nutritional,
          substrate for adaptation.
        range: string

      level:
        description: Quantitative level of the perturbation (e.g. 10.0 for 10 mg/L Cr(VI), 4.0 for 4 °C).
        range: float

      level_unit:
        description: Unit for `level` (e.g. "mg/L", "mM", "%", "°C", "µmol·m⁻²·s⁻¹").
        range: string

      ontology_id:
        description: >-
          Optional ontology CURIE for the perturbation type or agent
          (CHEBI for chemical agents, ENVO for environmental stress,
          NCIT for genetic-modification class, PATO for phenotypic
          qualities). Curator-supplied; pipeline does not auto-resolve.
          Renamed from `ontology_term` (G13) to align with the
          `<provenance>_id` convention used for bare-string CURIEs
          elsewhere in the schema. The typed-Term-object convention is
          `<provenance>_term`.
        range: string
        pattern: "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._-]*:[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$"

      evidence:
        description: Literature evidence supporting the perturbation claim.
        range: EvidenceItem
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

  StrainModification:
    description: >-
      A genotype/phenotype modification of the OrganismDescriptor's
      strain relative to the wild-type or type strain. Applies to the
      strain itself (carries across all media on which it grows), as
      distinct from PerturbationContext which applies per-observation.
    attributes:
      modification_type:
        description: Class of modification applied to the strain.
        range: StrainModificationTypeEnum
        required: true

      target:
        description: >-
          Gene/locus name, phenotype label, or substrate the modification
          targets (e.g. "magnetosome operon", "spo0A", "cellulose
          utilization").
        range: string

      description:
        description: Curator free-text describing the modification.
        range: string

      ontology_id:
        description: >-
          Optional CURIE — NCIT:C120956 (Knockout), NCIT:C17026
          (Genetic Modification), PATO:0015009 (mutant), etc.
          Renamed from `ontology_term` (G13) to align with the
          `<provenance>_id` convention used for bare-string CURIEs.
        range: string
        pattern: "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._-]*:[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$"

      evidence:
        description: Literature evidence supporting the modification claim.
        range: EvidenceItem
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

  NutrientOverride:
    description: >-
      A nutrient source used in this observation that differs from the
      medium's nominal recipe — typically a "sole carbon source",
      "sole nitrogen source", or specific electron donor/acceptor
      pairing the original recipe doesn't enforce. Distinct from the
      medium's prescribed `ingredients`; represents experimental
      substitution at observation time.
    attributes:
      role:
        description: >-
          Functional role the override supplies to the experiment (e.g.
          CARBON_SOURCE, NITROGEN_SOURCE, SULFUR_SOURCE, PHOSPHATE_SOURCE).
          Retargeted from the retired NutrientRoleEnum to the MIM-imported
          NutritionalRoleEnum (which is broader — 12 values covering all
          macronutrient / vitamin / cofactor supply categories). Values
          that used to fit under NutrientRoleEnum but not NutritionalRoleEnum
          (ELECTRON_DONOR, ELECTRON_ACCEPTOR) belong on the cellular-metabolic
          facet of the *ingredient* the override supplies, not on the
          override itself.
        range: NutritionalRoleEnum
        required: true

      source:
        description: e.g. "succinate", "L-phenylalanine", "acetate".
        range: string
        required: true

      ontology_id:
        description: Preferred CHEBI / FOODON CURIE for the source compound.
        range: string
        pattern: "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._-]*:[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$"

      is_sole_source:
        description: TRUE when this is the only source for that role in the experiment.
        range: boolean

      evidence:
        description: Literature evidence supporting the nutrient-override claim.
        range: EvidenceItem
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

  TemperatureValue:
    description: Temperature with units
    attributes:
      value:
        description: Numeric temperature value
        range: float
        required: true

      unit:
        description: Temperature unit
        range: TemperatureUnitEnum
        required: true

  PhRange:
    description: >-
      Acceptable pH range for a medium. Use `min` and `max` (floats) for
      parseable ranges; `notes` preserves the original free-text whenever
      a value can't be parsed cleanly (avoids data loss during migration).
    attributes:
      min:
        description: Lower bound of the acceptable pH range (inclusive).
        range: float
      max:
        description: Upper bound of the acceptable pH range (inclusive).
        range: float
      notes:
        description: >-
          Free-text qualifier or the original unparseable value
          (e.g. "varies by species", "alkaline 9-10 for halophiles").
        range: string

  PreparationStep:
    description: A step in medium preparation
    attributes:
      step_number:
        description: Sequential order
        range: integer
        required: true

      action:
        description: Action type
        range: PreparationActionEnum
        required: true

      description:
        description: Detailed instruction
        range: string
        required: true

      temperature:
        description: Temperature for this step
        range: TemperatureValue
        inlined: true

      duration:
        description: Time duration (e.g., "15 minutes", "overnight")
        range: string

      equipment:
        description: Required equipment (e.g., "autoclave", "magnetic stirrer")
        range: string

      notes:
        description: Additional tips or warnings
        range: string

  SterilizationDescriptor:
    description: Sterilization method and parameters
    attributes:
      method:
        description: Sterilization technique
        range: SterilizationMethodEnum
        required: true

      temperature:
        description: Temperature setting
        range: TemperatureValue
        inlined: true

      pressure:
        description: Pressure in psi or kPa (for autoclaving)
        range: float

      duration:
        description: Sterilization duration
        range: string

      notes:
        description: Special instructions (e.g., "Filter-sterilize heat-labile components separately")
        range: string

  StorageConditions:
    description: Storage requirements for prepared medium
    attributes:
      temperature:
        description: Storage temperature
        range: TemperatureValue
        required: true
        inlined: true

      light_condition:
        description: Light exposure requirement
        range: LightConditionEnum

      shelf_life:
        description: Duration of stability
        range: string

      container_type:
        description: Recommended container (e.g., "glass bottle", "polypropylene tube")
        range: string

      notes:
        description: Additional storage tips
        range: string

  MediaVariant:
    description: A variant or modification of the base recipe
    attributes:
      name:
        description: Variant name (e.g., "Low Salt LB", "LB + Ampicillin")
        required: true
        identifier: true
        range: string

      relationship:
        description: >-
          Typed relationship to the base recipe, drawn from the same enum
          that MediaRecipeReference.relationship uses. Curators should set
          this whenever a clean enum value applies; the free-text
          `modifications` slot remains for nuance or for variants whose
          relationship is genuinely composite.
        range: MediaVariantRelationshipEnum
        recommended: true

      description:
        description: Purpose and context
        range: string

      modifications:
        description: What differs from base recipe
        range: string
        multivalued: true

      purpose:
        description: Why this variant exists
        range: string

      supplier_info:
        description: Commercial supplier if premix
        range: SupplierInfo
        inlined: true

      evidence:
        description: Evidence supporting the variant
        range: EvidenceItem
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

  MediaRecipeReference:
    description: Reference to another CultureMech media recipe record
    attributes:
      id:
        description: Stable CultureMech identifier for the referenced media record
        range: string
        pattern: "^CultureMech:\\d{6}$"

      name:
        description: Referenced media recipe name
        range: string

      path:
        description: Repository-relative YAML path for the referenced media record
        range: string
        pattern: "^data/normalized_yaml/.+\\.ya?ml$"

      relationship:
        description: Parent-child relationship type for this link
        range: MediaVariantRelationshipEnum

      notes:
        description: Curator notes about the relationship or unresolved mapping
        range: string

      evidence:
        description: Evidence supporting the media parent-child relationship
        range: EvidenceItem
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

  SupplierInfo:
    description: Commercial supplier information
    attributes:
      supplier_name:
        description: Vendor name (e.g., "Sigma-Aldrich", "Thermo Fisher")
        range: string
        required: true

      catalog_number:
        description: Product catalog number
        range: string

      product_url:
        description: Direct product link
        range: uri

      notes:
        description: Additional sourcing notes
        range: string

  PublicationReference:
    description: Literature reference
    attributes:
      reference:
        description: Citation (PMID, DOI, or historical reference)
        range: string
        required: true
        implements:
          - linkml:authoritative_reference
        comments:
          - Use format PMID:12345678 or doi:10.1038/... for automatic validation.

      title:
        description: Publication title
        range: string

      authors:
        description: Author list
        range: string

      year:
        description: Publication year
        range: integer

      notes:
        description: Additional context about the reference
        range: string

  EvidenceItem:
    description: Evidence supporting a claim about media formulation or performance
    attributes:
      reference:
        description: Citation (PMID, DOI, or historical reference)
        range: string
        required: true
        identifier: true
        implements:
          - linkml:authoritative_reference
        comments:
          - This is automatically validated by the linkml-reference-validator tool.
          - Use format PMID:12345678 or doi:10.1038/... for automatic validation.
          - Acts as the natural identifier inside an `evidence:` list (no duplicates within a single record's evidence array).

      supports:
        description: Level of support
        range: EvidenceItemSupportEnum
        required: true

      snippet:
        description: Exact quote from paper (if PMID/DOI available)
        range: string
        implements:
          - linkml:excerpt
        comments:
          - This is automatically validated by the linkml-reference-validator tool.
          - Must be an exact substring of the cited paper's text.

      explanation:
        description: Why this evidence supports the claim
        range: string
        required: true

  CurationEvent:
    description: Audit trail entry for curation
    attributes:
      timestamp:
        description: ISO 8601 timestamp with a plausible 21st-century curation year
        range: string
        required: true
        pattern: "^20[0-9]{2}-"

      curator:
        description: Name or identifier of curator
        range: string
        required: true

      action:
        description: Action taken (created, updated, validated, etc.)
        range: string
        required: true

      notes:
        description: Additional context
        range: string

      changes:
        description: >-
          Structured summary of what changed in this event (free-text or
          semi-structured; used by automated curators e.g. `Set category
          to 'bacterial' (was: MISSING)`).
        range: string

      source:
        description: >-
          Source attribution for this curation event (e.g. a source PDF,
          a sibling CultureMech recipe, an external dataset).
        range: string

  SourceData:
    description: Provenance information for imported records
    attributes:
      origin:
        description: Source repository name
        range: string
        required: true
        examples:
          - value: CommunityMech
        comments:
          - Indicates which X-Mech repository this record was imported from

      community_ids:
        description: List of CommunityMech IDs this recipe was derived from
        range: string
        multivalued: true
        comments:
          - Enables bidirectional linking from CultureMech to CommunityMech
          - Format CommunityMech:NNNNNN

      import_date:
        description: Date of import (ISO 8601)
        range: string
        comments:
          - ISO 8601 date format YYYY-MM-DD

      evidence:
        description: Evidence records from source repository
        range: EvidenceItem
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        comments:
          - Preserves evidence from original CommunityMech record
          - Maintains literature references and provenance

      notes:
        description: Import notes and additional context
        range: string

      mediaingredientmech_id:
        description: >-
          MediaIngredientMech identifier for this imported solution record
          (carried when origin is `MediaIngredientMech`). Format
          `UNMAPPED_NNNN` or `MediaIngredientMech:NNNNNN`.
        range: string

  CofactorRequirement:
    description: Cofactor requirement for an organism
    attributes:
      cofactor:
        description: Required cofactor
        range: CofactorDescriptor
        required: true
        inlined: true

      can_biosynthesize:
        description: Whether organism can synthesize this cofactor
        range: boolean
        required: true

      confidence:
        description: Confidence level (0.0-1.0) based on genome annotation
        range: float

      evidence:
        description: Supporting evidence for requirement
        range: EvidenceItem
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      genes:
        description: Genes related to biosynthesis or utilization
        range: string
        multivalued: true

  TransporterAnnotation:
    description: Annotation of a transporter or transport system
    attributes:
      name:
        description: Transporter name or gene name
        required: true
        range: string

      transporter_type:
        description: Classification of transporter
        range: TransporterTypeEnum
        required: true

      substrates:
        description: Transported substrates
        range: string
        multivalued: true

      substrate_terms:
        description: CHEBI terms for substrates
        range: ChemicalEntityTerm
        bindings:
          - binds_value_of: id
            obligation_level: REQUIRED
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

      direction:
        description: Transport direction (import, export, bidirectional)
        range: string

      genes:
        description: Gene names or locus tags
        range: string
        multivalued: true

      ec_number:
        description: EC number if enzymatic
        range: string

      notes:
        description: Additional functional notes
        range: string

# ================================================================
# ONTOLOGY TERM CLASSES
# ================================================================

  ChemicalEntityTerm:
    is_a: Term
    description: >-
      A term identifying a chemical or biological ingredient. Primarily CHEBI,
      with FOODON / UBERON / ENVO accepted for ingredients (food products,
      anatomical tissues, environmental samples) where no CHEBI equivalent
      exists upstream. `mediadive.compound:*` is also accepted as the
      upstream MediaDive grounding kept alongside CHEBI mappings on
      solution-composition entries. MICRO (Ontology of Prokaryotic
      Phenotypic and Metabolic Characters) is accepted for enzymatic
      protein digests (tryptone, peptone, proteose peptone, soy peptone,
      casein hydrolysate) which ChEBI cannot represent because
      CHEBI:59999 "chemical substance" requires constant composition.
    slot_usage:
      id:
        pattern: "^(CHEBI|FOODON|MICRO|UBERON|ENVO|mediadive\\.compound):\\w+$"
    id_prefixes:
      - CHEBI
      - FOODON
      - MICRO
      - UBERON
      - ENVO
      - mediadive.compound

  ChebiTerm:
    is_a: Term
    description: >-
      A strictly-CHEBI term reference. Use for the `chebi_term` slot where
      the contract is "this is the CHEBI grounding specifically" — distinct
      from the polymorphic `ChemicalEntityTerm` used by `term` slots that
      may carry upstream non-CHEBI IDs.
    slot_usage:
      id:
        pattern: "^CHEBI:\\d+$"
    id_prefixes:
      - CHEBI

  OrganismTerm:
    is_a: Term
    description: An NCBITaxon term representing an organism
    slot_usage:
      id:
        pattern: "^NCBITaxon:\\d+$"
    id_prefixes:
      - NCBITaxon

  GTDBTerm:
    is_a: Term
    description: >-
      A GTDB genome identifier. id = GTDB accession (e.g. GTDB:RS_GCF_000006945.2),
      label = full GTDB lineage string (e.g. d__Bacteria;p__Proteobacteria;...)
    id_prefixes:
      - GTDB

  MediaDatabaseTerm:
    is_a: Term
    description: Identifier from authoritative media database
    id_prefixes:
      - mediadive.medium  # MediaDive REST API format (for kg-microbe compatibility)
      - komodo.medium     # KOMODO ModelSEED format (for kg-microbe compatibility)
      - DSMZ
      - TOGO
      - ATCC
      - NCIT

  MediaIngredientMechTerm:
    is_a: Term
    description: >-
      A legacy MediaIngredientMech identifier (MediaIngredientMech:NNNNNN)
      for a media ingredient. MediaIngredientMech has since migrated to a
      CHEBI-keyed schema and no longer mints these IDs; for new linkages use
      `mediaingredientmech_chebi_term` instead. Retained for the existing
      corpus, which still carries these IDs.
    slot_usage:
      id:
        pattern: "^MediaIngredientMech:\\d{6}$"
    id_prefixes:
      - MediaIngredientMech

  MediaIngredientMechChebiTerm:
    is_a: Term
    description: >-
      CHEBI-keyed linkage to a MediaIngredientMech curated ingredient.
      MediaIngredientMech migrated from minting `MediaIngredientMech:NNNNNN`
      ids to keying its curated ingredient entities by CHEBI; this term records
      the matched MIM entity's CHEBI identifier (with the MIM `preferred_term`
      as label). Distinct from the ingredient's own `term`/`chebi_term`
      grounding: it asserts "this ingredient corresponds to a curated MIM
      ingredient", even though the id coincides with the CHEBI grounding.
    slot_usage:
      id:
        pattern: "^CHEBI:\\d+$"
    id_prefixes:
      - CHEBI

  CultureMechTerm:
    is_a: Term
    description: A CultureMech identifier for a media recipe used as component
    slot_usage:
      id:
        pattern: "^CultureMech:\\d{6}$"
        description: CultureMech identifier (e.g., "CultureMech:009592")
    id_prefixes:
      - CultureMech
    comments:
      - Used when one medium references another medium as an ingredient or component
      - "Example: BG-11 Trace Metals Solution (CultureMech:015441) used in BG-11 Medium"

  EnvironmentTerm:
    is_a: Term
    description: An ENVO term representing an environmental system or biome
    slot_usage:
      id:
        pattern: "^ENVO:\\d{7,8}$"
        description: ENVO identifier (7-8 digit format)
    id_prefixes:
      - ENVO
    comments:
      - ENVO prefix already defined in schema prefixes
      - Pattern allows both 7 and 8 digit ENVO IDs
      - "Examples: ENVO:00000044 (peatland), ENVO:00002149 (sea water)"

  ImportMetadata:
    description: >-
      Tracking information for imported media records.
      Enables versioning, provenance tracking, and reproducible updates.
    attributes:
      source_database:
        description: Source database from which this medium was imported
        range: SourceDatabaseEnum
        required: true

      source_id:
        description: >-
          Original identifier in source database (e.g., "Medium 1234", "M3205").
          Preserved for traceability and update tracking.
        range: string
        required: true

      import_version:
        description: >-
          Import version following format vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH_YYYY-MM-DD.
          Example: v1.0.0_2026-01-27
        range: string
        required: true
        pattern: "^v\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+_\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$"

      import_date:
        description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was imported
        range: string
        required: true

      import_skill:
        description: >-
          Name of the skill or script that performed the import.
          Example: "import-mediadive", "import-togo-skill"
        range: string

      last_updated:
        description: ISO 8601 timestamp of most recent update
        range: string

      update_history:
        description: >-
          Chronological log of all updates applied to this record.
          Enables full audit trail from initial import to present.
        range: UpdateEvent
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true

  UpdateEvent:
    description: >-
      Record of a single update to an imported media recipe.
      Captures what changed, when, and why.
    attributes:
      timestamp:
        description: ISO 8601 timestamp when update was applied
        range: string
        required: true

      import_version:
        description: Import version that applied this update
        range: string
        required: true

      action:
        description: Type of update action performed
        range: UpdateActionEnum
        required: true

      fields_changed:
        description: >-
          List of field names that were modified in this update.
          Example: ["ingredients", "ph_value", "description"]
        range: string
        multivalued: true

      notes:
        description: >-
          Human-readable explanation of the update.
          Why was this change made? What was the context?
        range: string

# ================================================================
# ENUMERATIONS
# ================================================================

enums:
  RecordKindEnum:
    description: >-
      Whether a normalized_yaml record describes a growth medium or a standalone
      stock solution. See the `record_kind` slot: this is stated only where the
      `term.id` prefix cannot carry the distinction.
    permissible_values:
      MEDIUM:
        description: A growth medium.
      SOLUTION:
        description: >-
          A standalone stock solution (trace elements, vitamins, buffers). Excluded
          from media-level audits and from the deep-research ranking.
  MediumTypeEnum:
    description: >-
      Single-axis classification of culture medium, MAINTAINED alongside the three
      orthogonal axes rather than replaced by them. It conflates composition,
      nutritional level and functional role into one slot, which is why
      MediumCompositionTypeEnum (composition_type), MediumNutritionalClassEnum
      (nutritional_class) and MediumFunctionalRoleEnum (functional_role) exist and
      are the primary axes for new curation. This enum remains the published
      single-valued view: populate BOTH, and keep this slot derived from
      composition_type. The per-value "Migrates to" notes below define that
      derivation and are parsed by the consistency guard, so they are load-bearing
      documentation rather than historical commentary.
    permissible_values:
      DEFINED:
        description: Chemically defined medium with known composition. Migrates to
          composition_type=DEFINED.
        meaning: NCIT:C64372
      COMPLEX:
        description: Medium with undefined components (e.g., yeast extract). Migrates to
          composition_type=UNDEFINED.
        meaning: NCIT:C64371
      SELECTIVE:
        description: Medium that selects for specific organisms. Migrates to
          functional_role=[SELECTIVE].
      DIFFERENTIAL:
        description: Medium that differentiates organism types. Migrates to
          functional_role=[DIFFERENTIAL].
      ENRICHMENT:
        description: Medium that enriches for specific organisms. Migrates to
          functional_role=[ENRICHMENT].
      MINIMAL:
        description: Medium with minimal nutrients required for growth. Migrates to
          nutritional_class=MINIMAL.
      BUFFER:
        description: Buffer solution (e.g. PBS) — not a growth medium per se but stored alongside media for context.
      NEGATIVE_CONTROL:
        description: Negative-control "medium" used as an experimental baseline (e.g. distilled water).
